isolation: Angolar / Ngola only, spoken on São Tomé. This is not Angola Contruy and not data/angola_dataset/. Do not insert Forro, Lung’Ie, Cabo Verdean, Guinea-Bissau, Angola Contruy, Kimbundu, Umbundu, or Angolan Portuguese.
principle: Zero hallucination. Missing data is preferable to incorrect data.

Bandeira, Manuele. 2017. Reconstrução fonológica e lexical do protocrioulo do Golfo da Guiné. Tese de doutorado, Universidade de São Paulo. Angolar phonology chapter and Chapter 5 AN column only.

extraction_notes: Angolar entries are isolated from the comparative seed and its named sources. No Forro headword was copied into this folder. Additional verified items were added from Maurer 2013 APiCS survey chapters and from Angolar/Lung’Ie-labelled lines in Rougé and Schang 2012. Portuguese is null when the source only gives an English (or French) gloss. No Forro headword was copied into this folder. Further items were added from open academic web sources (USP thesis; SciELO). Languages remain isolated. Portuguese is null when the source only gives English. Further Angolar items were added from Bandeira 2017 (Angolar phonology chapter and Chapter 5 AN column) and Bandeira, Agostinho & Freitas 2021. Further items were added from Bandeira 2017 Chapter 5 cognate tables, using only the language-specific column. Further labelled items were added from Bandeira, Agostinho & Freitas 2021 (Angolar running-text examples) and Bandeira & Araujo 2022 (language-isolated cells and examples). Portuguese remains null when a source does not print Portuguese.

entries.cultural_context: Maroon creole of western and south-eastern São Tomé. Main villages: Santa Catarina, São João dos Angolares, Ribeira Peixe. Fishing community. About 15 percent of the lexicon is Bantu, mostly Kimbundu (Maurer 1992, APiCS). Forro label for the group: ngola (Dicionario livre santome.txt). Do not treat that Forro ethnonym as an Angolar headword.
